_help: The Kalender tab's fixed events (src/radar/calendar.py): summits, the big elections and Danish dates of the next 12-18 months. Every date is checked against an official or reputable source, given in 'link' (checked 2026-10-17); an event whose date cannot be checked is left out (NATO 2027, G7 2027, BRICS 2027, APEC 2027, SCO 2027, COP32, the Arab League's and the OIC's next summits had no announced dates; the finance bill's final vote has no published day). Fields: id (lowercase-with-hyphens, stable: it is the share link's ?kalender=), date (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM with approx), end (the last day of a meeting of several days), approx (true: 'forventet'), title (Danish, reality only), kind (valg | topmøde | centralbank | frist | retssag | forhandling | dansk | andet), place, why (one factual line: why it matters, never a forecast), link. Israel's name is written “israel”. Past events drop from the app after 30 days.
